notes.title: Cryspace "Tender, Love, and Care" Update & Leaving Early Access
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

It's been a while, but I'm extremely excited to announce this new build of Cryspace. This build contains many quality-of-life updates, many of which have been requested in the Steam Community Forums. If you haven't already been posting there, and if you do have any additional feedback from the game moving forward, please consider posting a thread there! Otherwise, please see the most recent patch notes below:

[h1]New Themes and Theme Updates![/h1]
Today's update brings the addition of new themes - Gold, Mint, and Pink. In addition, theme selection is now available from the Main Menu, making it easy to select your favorite theme prior to jumping in to the game and story itself.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43683561/fbe0364453872e451dfe8c9db188c65238cdced7.jpg[/img]

[h1]Features for Speedrunners/Replayers/Streamers[/h1]
As a much requested feature, I'm happy to announce it is now much easier to replay the game multiple times. Simply go to the "Settings" section on either the Main Menu, and find the brand-new "Immersion Speed" setting. This setting will change the pace in which characters respond to your messages, so whether you prefer a slower pace, giving you more time to read character's messages, or whether you want to breeze through them at double the speed, you now have the freedom to make that choice. Indeed, I've noticed talk about characters taking a while to respond to messages in the "web view" of the game, so whether you're rushing through the story, or if you simply want to control the pacing of it, you may do so in whichever way you please via this setting.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43683561/cd61b45d11fbfc3b2398f93e4df44a6c4a12fe4a.jpg[/img]

In addition, there is now a new feature in the "Scene View" sections of the game (ie. going out on dates, hanging out with friends, etc.). This feature allows you to skip all dialogue until it is time for you to make a decision. While I wouldn't recommend first-time players to mess around too much with this, I think it'll be helpful for those of you who are repeating the story, and want to get straight to the point. With a click of a button, you will be immediately skipped to the next decision in the game, and depending on your use, you won't have to re-read parts of the story you've been through previously. [b]Please note this feature is experimental, and may result in unintended behavior. While every possible effort has been made to test it, bugs may occur. Report these on the Steam Community Forums![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43683561/b5548317d7b252a77d5091af1336a8e56f2051b5.jpg[/img]

[h1]New Debug/Backup Tool[/h1]
A small group of players have reported bugs within certain parts of the story, and it has been hard for me to find the root cause of them without having access to their saved data. As a result of this, a new debug tool has been created, allowing you to easily put all of your saved files in a ZIP archive, and either use them for your own purposes, or send them to me to allow for easy debugging. I am committed to the quality of this game, and any time someone reports a bug, I am equally committed to fixing it promptly.

The debug tool appears in a console application (as seen below), and by simply typing "export", you can archive all of your current saved data into a convenient ZIP package. Depending on the nature of your use, you can now easily send any buggy files over to me, or, you can simply have a backup of your current saved data. This tool also shows you which path on your computer the saved data is stored in, so you can easily extract the archive there, and restore any data you wish to preserve. This tool is extremely useful for bug reporting/easily creating a snapshot of that data for your use. You will find this as an additional launch option when opening the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43683561/1f84c38d68b58b098da6803fa5cb954f58b2f283.png[/img]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
There were a few (major/minor?) bugs that were haunting the game, such as text being jumbled when you make a decision too quickly, and issues where changing your theme wouldn't always change everything accordingly. These issues have been squashed entirely. If you run into any further issues, please use the aforementioned debug tool, and contact me at jimmy@jimmydiamondgames.com, and I'd be happy to look into it for you.

[h1]Steam Autumn Sale[/h1]
As a result of the Steam Autumn Sale, Cryspace's Full Story is now 20% off! If you don't already own the Full Story, you may [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2448740/Cryspace__Full_Game/]click here[/url] to learn more about it, and purchase it as this discount lasts!

[h1]What about Workshop/Other Love Interests?[/h1]
You may notice references to the Workshop feature and other love interests have been hidden from the game. This is due to confusion caused by players who may have purchased the Full Game DLC or completed a full story playthrough with Sam, and being unsure as to why these features were not yet available. These features may make a debut at a later date, but for now, I removed all references to them to avoid any confusion these unimplemented features may stir up.

[h1]Conclusion[/h1]
In this update, you will find many quality-of-life changes that make replaying the game easier, give you more options to tailor your own experience, and ultimately, provide a better experience overall. As such, it only felt appropriate to release the game out of Early Access into Full Release. Does this mean that updates are going away? No! Keep talking about the game or providing feedback in the Steam Community Forums, and I'd be happy to engage with you further. I love this community, the feedback I've acquired over the past few months, and I am fully committed to providing a great experience. I hope you enjoy this update, and for those committed Cryspace players out there, I hope it allows you to replay the game in a much easier, streamlined way. Please enjoy this free update, and let me know if you have any questions/concerns. Thank you!

notes.title: Cryspace Release
notes.notes:
It's been a long time coming, but I'm happy to announce that Cryspace is now available!

[h1]Features on Launch[/h1]
[list]
[*]Enjoy the first two dates with Sam/Samuel for FREE (or experience the full story with the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2448740/Cryspace__Full_Game]Full Game DLC[/url]).
[*]Play as either a male or a female protagonist with corresponding love interests.
[*]Customize the site to your liking with five distinct themes (with more to come in future updates).
[*]Experience several branching paths, offering near infinite replayability.
[*]Experience ten different major ending categories, with [b]over SEVENTY endings in total[/b] (some available for free, all available with the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2448740/Cryspace__Full_Game]Full Game DLC[/url]).
[*]Twenty unique achievements, including hidden achievements.
[*]Varying game-play between the "Website" view, and a more traditional visual novel experience.
[*]A story the length of approximately 2.5x the average novel (with the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2448740/Cryspace__Full_Game]Full Game DLC[/url], and accounting for all branching paths).
[*]And more!
[/list]
[h1]Full Game DLC Discount![/h1]
To celebrate the launch, I've discounted the Full Game DLC by 20%. What is this DLC you might ask? This DLC grants you access to the entirety of Sam/Samuel's story, and gives you access to any additional stories (as well as the upcoming workshop feature) upon release in their entirety. This discount ends on October 8th, so take advantage of it while you can!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2448740/Cryspace__Full_Game/

[h1]Early Access Period[/h1]
This is an Early Access release, and the title plans on leaving Early Access once the Workshop/Story Editing features are available, which can be anticipated within the next few weeks to a month or two. As the title is in Early Access, I'd love to hear your thoughts as the game moves through it. Please don't shy away from posting in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2310440/]Community Forums[/url] - there is a good chance your suggestions may make it into an update!

[h1]Enjoy Cryspace![/h1]
I sincerely hope you enjoy the game. I put a lot of work into it, and I think with all of its branching paths and varying endings, you will find a game that has a lot to uncover, and a game that has much to offer in terms of replayability compared to many other visual novels. As alluded to in the previous section, your suggestions/feedback/etc. are incredibly important to me, and throughout this Early Access period, I will do my best to iterate/improve upon the game based on what you have to say. I look forward to seeing what you have to say, and talking with you as we move through the development stages. For now, though, have fun with the game, and enjoy Sam's story!

notes.title: Early Access + Confirmed Release Date!
notes.notes:
It's been a while since I've made an announcement about Cryspace, but I feel it's time to shed some light on the project:

I have made the decision to transition the title to Early Access. I do not want to cause any further delays, and I'd like to get some of the game out for everyone to experience and continue iterating from there based on user feedback.

[h1]What will be available on launch?[/h1]
Sam Winters' entire story will be playable on day one of release. Her story alone will provide hours of content especially if you play through all of the available branching paths (there are many!). I cannot stress how important your decisions will be during your playthroughs, and I sincerely believe you'll enjoy playing through every one of them. 

[h1]What about Alexis/Vanesa fans?[/h1]
These characters will be implemented down the line, and for those of you who have played the demo, your saved data is safe. They will be fully available in future updates to the game post-release. On Day 1 of Early Access release, saved data with Alexis and Vanesa will be unavailable to load, but once these characters are released, you may access that saved data again.

[h1]Male Love Interests/Female Protagonist?[/h1]
For those of you who have requested the ability to play from a feminine perspective, I've got you covered. From day one, you will have the ability to select your gender on the profile creation screen, which will change the love interests and some gender-specific story elements.

[h1]Full Game DLC?[/h1]
Cryspace is a free game, meaning anyone can pick it up and give the game a shot for a reasonable amount of time (about an hour's worth of gameplay). To clarify on the available [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2448740/cryspace__Full_Game/]Full Game DLC[/url], this will grant you access to Sam Winters' full story on launch, and any future updates (custom stories, Alexis/Vanesa's full story arcs, whatever else might be released in the future) will be yours for free. There will be no future DLC releases, meaning that [b]if you purchase the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2448740/cryspace__Full_Game/]Full Game DLC[/url], the entire game and all future updates will be available to you with no additional charges[/b]. This, of course, includes Alexis and Vanesa as selectable love interests, and the story editor. There will never be any additional DLC available for Cryspace. Free-to-play players will also benefit from these future updates, unlocking partial access to Alexis'/Vanesa's story arcs as they are released at no charge.

[h1]Why Early Access?[/h1]
I've said from the beginning that I don't plan to release an unfinished product on release, and this still holds true. The game you receive on day one of Early Access could be considered a full product in it of itself with the amount of branching paths available to you as well as the amount of features, and the hours of content you will be able to play through as a result. Early Access is necessary as I've spent a lot of development time simply working on Sam's story alone, and naturally, I intend to release more love interests. Frankly, I need more time to write engaging stories for these other love interests, and I don't want to keep anyone waiting any longer to experience a full playthrough of Cryspace. Overall, I feel Early Access to be a proper tag as I want to keep adding/iterating to the game post-release. Once all the love interests are implemented as well as the custom stories, the game will be out of Early Access.

[h1]When will the game be released in Early Access?[/h1]
With this announcement, [b]I am proud to announce an updated release of October 1st, 2024[/b]. As mentioned, Sam Winters' entire story will be available on Day 1 with the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2448740/cryspace__Full_Game/]Full Game DLC[/url], and a partial story will be available for those without this DLC. This may seem a bit far out, but it is a necessity in order to finish all of the branching paths, add art and music to the game where appropriate, make some other quality-of-life changes, and to test the game and every path available.

For everyone who has wishlisted the game thus far, [b]thank you[/b]. For the curators who've reviewed the game, [b]thank you[/b]. I am committed to providing a great experience throughout every stage of development with the community's suggestions taken into account. I truly believe I have made a great game, and I am anxious to see what you all think about Sam's story once you have the chance to experience it for yourself. Thanks again for your patience, and I look forward to your reactions of the game once it is available.

notes.title: Commitment to Cryspace
notes.notes:
I wanted to take some time to go over the direction of the game, and reevaluating the expected release date for it.

[h1]Release Date Update and Progress[/h1]
Cryspace is still being worked on daily, and much progress has been made since my previous last couple of announcements. That said, I'm in a position currently where I must delay the game for likely another few months (hence the TBA on the store page). This is due to the fact that I am committed to making several branching paths/unique endings/Easter eggs/etc.

From a technical standpoint, the game is complete; it's the story that needs to be finalized and polished, and I want to make sure that everyone who plays has control over where their story goes, and is satisfied with the ending(s) they receive as a result of their actions. Sure, i could release the game at the end of this month, rush the endings and the dialogue, and ship it on time, but I'd much prefer to release something that is well thought out, polished, moderately lengthy, and fleshed out with content, so much so that is re-playable with little overlap in the story from run-to-run.

[h1]The Future Ahead[/h1]
I think that what would most benefit the game currently is having a publisher to oversee its production, have people test the game currently, and writers/editors to ensure that the story is the absolute best it could be. As such, this is something I will be actively pursuing and hopefully, I am able to land a partnership with those that can bring out the very best in this game.

Even without a publisher, I am confident I can finish the game on my own, and that it would be a fulfilling experience start to finish. That said, I'm one guy working a full-time job, and I believe a partnership with a reputable publisher will help get this title finished faster, offer a second opinion on both the story amongst other decisions, and is ultimately the direction that I would like to move in.

[h1]Conclusion[/h1]
Thank you to everyone who has played the demo(s) of the game thus far, and I promise this game has my full commitment until it is complete. As soon as I have a better idea of a time-frame moving forward, I will update you accordingly.

notes.title: Cryspace Development Update + Seeking Beta Testers
notes.notes:
As the sole developer of Cryspace, I wanted to take some time to discuss development progress as well as announce a change to the expected release date.

[h1]Release Date Announcement/Expectations Upon Release[/h1]
To be clear, nothing is changing in regards to the game's features. [b]The entire story will be available, alongside the editor, Steam Workshop support, etc. on day one of the game's release.[/b] That being said, the game's release is being pushed from September 1st of this year to November 30th.

The reason for this change is that, when this game releases, I want it to be complete. That's not to say there won't be updates post-release (there will be!), but as far as the core features go, I need to allocate myself this extra time to ensure that everything is prepared, polished, perfected, and good to go.

[h1]By the Numbers[/h1]
To put in perspective the progress made on the story so far, I have prepared a list of statistics for your amusement:

As of today, there are:
[olist]
[*]2,348 messages sent by characters.
[*]271 opportunities to respond to characters, and influence the story.
[*]Approximately 867 branching paths/unique dialogue sequences influenced by your responses, and character's opinions about you.
[*]17 endings developed so far, most of which are a result of negative interactions with characters.
[*]5,576 lines of "story script", which tells the game how to execute the story.
[/olist]
[h1]Why the Change?[/h1]
As the only person working on this game, as well as the fact that I am working full-time, it is a necessity. This is not a decision that I've made lightly, but I'd rather delay the game until November than release an incomplete product in September. Rest assured, I'm working practically everyday to make this game as good as it can be.

While I could likely finish, for example, the story by September, that would leave out the editor, Steam Workshop, etc. and leave me no time to apply any "final touches" prior to release. I have all the intention in the world to ship out a fully featured, complete game on day one of release as to not keep any of you waiting for the next "chapter" of the story, the ability to make your own stories, or use any of the other features. I've played a lot of games in the past in which I've been left on cliffhangers only to be told I have to wait a year to continue playing, and I'm not going to take that approach with this game or any other game that I make.

[h1]Demo Update[/h1]
The demo will be updated with an additional segment of the story on September 15th.

[h1]Beta Testing[/h1]
As the branching paths, story, and features progress further, I am in need of beta testers. Should you be interested, please add me on Steam, or shoot me at an email at jimmydiamond289@gmail.com.


All in all, I look forward to delivering a quality game with tons of replay value very soon. Thanks to everyone who's wishlisted and/or followed the game so far. I appreciate your support!

notes.title: Free Demo Now Available!
notes.notes:
The first demo version of Cryspace is now publicly available from now until the end of the month. This demo encompasses the first pivotal events of the game, including deciding which girl you'd like to pursue, and resolving a heated conflict between your best friend and an unknown assailant. [b]Every decision you make in the demo will be saved, and will be compatible with the full version once it is released.[/b]

An average play-through of the demo takes about fifteen minutes, though I encourage you to create multiple saves and try out the different dialogue options/choices to get the full experience. Each decision you make in the game, no matter how trivial, can and may be cross-referenced by characters either later in the demo, or in the full version of the game. Feel free to play around, explore each character's personality, and have fun trying things out!

Beginning July 1st, this demo will no longer be available for download. You can look forward to an extended demo that will expand upon the events of this demo, and offer a more refined experience available on August 1st.

Have fun!
